purpose: Screens a role against a fixed rubric to decide whether Aishwar is a fit. Published so anyone can check the output against the rules. The verdict is computed from this file by screener.js; no language model assigns it.

verdict_rules.note: Bands are percentages of the maximum weighted score. Below the partial threshold the band is weak.

gates.label: Experience floor
gates.question: How many years of full-time experience does the role require?
gates.reason: Zero full-time post-graduation experience. Roughly 7 months across three internships, all while enrolled. Below four years there is a real case to be made. Above it there is not.
gates.near_note: The posting asks for more years than I have. On paper this is a miss, and my experience is internships rather than full-time. The case for talking anyway is in the criteria below.
gates.fail_note: This role wants four or more years of full-time experience. I have none, and no amount of fit on the other criteria changes that.
gates.pass_note: The experience bar is within reach. Internships rather than years, but the posting does not rule me out.

gates.label: Work authorization
gates.question: Is this role on-site outside India, without visa sponsorship?
gates.reason: Based in Mumbai. Geography is geography.
gates.fail_note: This role requires being on-site outside India with no sponsorship. That is a hard stop, not a preference.
gates.pass_note: No work authorization problem. I can do this from where I am.

gates.label: Production ownership
gates.question: What level of system ownership does this role carry?
gates.reason: Prototypes and research signals are a different discipline from keeping a system alive under load with an on-call rotation and SLAs.
gates.near_note: This role ships to real users. I have built things that worked in the field, but not under a formal reliability bar. Worth discussing what the real expectation is.
gates.fail_note: This role owns production systems at scale, with a pager and SLAs. That is not my track record and pretending otherwise would waste your time.

options.label: Ships to real users, no formal on-call
Production at scale, on-call and SLAs

gates.pass_note: The ownership level matches what I have actually done: prototypes, research and analysis.

gates.label: Scope shape
gates.question: How is the scope of this role shaped?
gates.reason: Breadth across ambiguous problems is the whole argument. In a deep specialist lane that breadth is dead weight and you should hire a specialist.
gates.near_note: The remit is defined but has room to range. That can work. The question is how much of the job is inside the lines.
gates.fail_note: This is a narrow specialist role, one stack, multi-year depth. You want someone who has spent those years. That is not me.

options.label: Broad. The problem is not yet defined
A defined remit with room to range
A narrow specialist lane, one stack

gates.pass_note: The scope is broad enough for the way I work.

gates.label: Over-qualification
gates.question: Is the work pure execution against a brief that is already fully specified?
gates.reason: Inverse gate. If the problem is already defined and the job is to execute it, I would be bored in four months and leave, which is a worse outcome for you than a no today.
gates.fail_note: The work is execution against a settled brief. I would take it, do it, and be restless by month four. You deserve someone who wants that job.
gates.pass_note: The problem is not fully specified yet, which is the part I am good at.

gates.label: Availability
gates.question: When does this role need someone to start, and is it full-time?
gates.reason: I graduate in June 2027. Before that I am available for internships and part-time remote work, not a full-time role.
gates.near_note: The start date lands in my final term. Part-time until June 2027 and full-time after is possible, but it needs saying out loud rather than discovering it in week two.
gates.fail_note: This role needs someone full-time before 2027. I am an undergraduate until June 2027, so this is a hard conflict rather than a preference.
gates.pass_note: The timing works. Either it is part-time, or it starts after I graduate in June 2027.

criteria.label: Problem ambiguity
criteria.scale: 0 = fully specced before handover, 10 = nobody yet knows what the question is
criteria.question: How well defined is a problem when you hand it to someone?

criteria.label: Analysis and build mix
criteria.scale: 0 = purely one or the other, 10 = the same person does the analysis and ships the thing
criteria.question: Does this role both analyse and build?

options.label: Mostly one, some of the other
The same person analyses and ships

criteria.label: Team size
criteria.question: How many people are in the company?

criteria.label: Company stage
criteria.scale: 0 = late stage or public, 10 = pre-seed or pre-product
criteria.question: What stage is the company at?

criteria.label: Quantitative content
criteria.scale: 0 = no numbers involved, 10 = the core of the job is quantitative
criteria.question: How much of this work is quantitative?

criteria.label: Direct customer contact
criteria.scale: 0 = never speaks to a customer, 10 = in front of customers weekly
criteria.question: Does this role talk to customers directly?

criteria.label: Capability overlap
criteria.scale: Scored on cluster overlap, not keyword matching. 0 = no cluster applies, 10 = two or more clusters are central to the role.
criteria.question: Which of these capability clusters does the role actually draw on?
criteria.note: Replaces keyword skill matching. A gate that passes on a single shared word passes always, and reproduces the ATS behaviour this system exists to avoid.

criteria.label: Autonomy expected
criteria.scale: 0 = work is assigned and reviewed daily, 10 = expected to find the work and decide what matters
criteria.question: How much autonomy does this role carry?
criteria.note: Replaces cultural alignment, which is too vague to score and is a known bias vector. Autonomy is a question a founder can actually answer.

options.label: Work is assigned and reviewed daily
Owns outcomes, checks in as needed
Finds the work and decides what matters

probes.text: Think about the last thing you handed to someone new. How specced was it when you handed it over?
Your most recent hire, three weeks in. What were they doing without checking with you first?
Six months in, what has this person done that you would be disappointed if they hadn't?
When this role produces something, who consumes it? A dashboard, a deploy, or a decision someone makes?
If the thing this person owns breaks at 2am, who gets paged?
What is the part of this job you are hoping you never have to explain to them?

known_false_negatives.note: Some founders will hire a strong part-timer and convert them on graduation. A NEAR here is often worth a conversation, and a FAIL is occasionally negotiable if the start date is soft.

Early-stage founders routinely write '3+ years' in a posting and hire someone with none of it because they liked how the person thought. A NEAR here is very often still worth a conversation. Recalibrated 2026-09-05 from PASS 0-2 / FAIL 5+ to PASS 0-1 / FAIL 4+, because zero full-time years should not read as a clean pass against a two-year requirement.
'Who gets paged' separates pre-scale from post-scale companies well, but a founder who has never had an incident may answer as though they are post-scale when they are not.
Job postings describe scope aspirationally. A role written as narrow is sometimes broad in practice at a small company, and this gate takes the posting at its word.

G1.label: Umbral de experiencia
G1.question: ¿Cuántos años de experiencia a tiempo completo exige el puesto?
G1.reason: Cero experiencia a tiempo completo tras graduarme. Unos 7 meses en tres prácticas, todas mientras estudiaba. Por debajo de cuatro años hay un caso real. Por encima, no.
G1.near_note: La oferta pide más años de los que tengo. Sobre el papel es un fallo, y mi experiencia son prácticas, no tiempo completo. El argumento para hablar de todos modos está en los criterios de abajo.
G1.fail_note: Este puesto quiere cuatro o más años a tiempo completo. No los tengo, y ningún encaje en los demás criterios cambia eso.
G1.pass_note: El listón de experiencia está a mi alcance. Prácticas en lugar de años, pero la oferta no me descarta.

G2.label: Autorización de trabajo
G2.question: ¿Es un puesto presencial fuera de India, sin patrocinio de visado?
G2.reason: Vivo en Bombay. La geografía es la geografía.
G2.fail_note: Este puesto exige estar presencialmente fuera de India sin patrocinio. Es un no rotundo, no una preferencia.
G2.pass_note: Sin problema de autorización de trabajo. Puedo hacerlo desde donde estoy.

G3.label: Propiedad de producción
G3.question: ¿Qué nivel de propiedad de sistemas conlleva el puesto?
G3.reason: Los prototipos y las señales de investigación son una disciplina distinta de mantener un sistema vivo bajo carga, con guardias y SLAs.
G3.near_note: Este puesto llega a usuarios reales. He construido cosas que funcionaron en campo, pero no bajo un umbral formal de fiabilidad. Vale la pena hablar de cuál es la expectativa real.
G3.fail_note: Este puesto opera sistemas en producción a escala, con guardias y SLAs. No es mi trayectoria, y fingir lo contrario te haría perder el tiempo.
options: Llega a usuarios reales, sin guardia formal
Producción a escala, guardias y SLAs
G3.pass_note: El nivel de propiedad coincide con lo que he hecho: prototipos, investigación y análisis.

G4.label: Forma del ámbito
G4.question: ¿Cómo está definido el ámbito del puesto?
G4.reason: La amplitud ante problemas ambiguos es todo el argumento. En un carril especialista profundo esa amplitud es peso muerto, y deberías contratar a un especialista.
G4.near_note: El ámbito está definido pero tiene espacio para moverse. Puede funcionar. La pregunta es cuánto del trabajo queda dentro de las líneas.
G4.fail_note: Es un puesto especialista estrecho, un solo stack, profundidad de varios años. Quieres a alguien que haya pasado esos años. Ese no soy yo.
options: Amplio. El problema aún no está definido
Un ámbito definido con espacio para moverse
Un carril especialista estrecho, un solo stack
G4.pass_note: El ámbito es lo bastante amplio para mi forma de trabajar.

G5.label: Sobrecualificación
G5.question: ¿Es trabajo de pura ejecución sobre un encargo ya totalmente especificado?
G5.reason: Puerta inversa. Si el problema ya está definido y el trabajo es ejecutarlo, me aburriría en cuatro meses y me iría, lo cual es peor para ti que un no hoy.
G5.fail_note: El trabajo es ejecución sobre un encargo cerrado. Lo aceptaría, lo haría, y estaría inquieto para el cuarto mes. Mereces a alguien que quiera ese trabajo.
G5.pass_note: El problema todavía no está del todo definido, que es la parte que se me da bien.

G6.label: Disponibilidad
G6.question: ¿Cuándo necesita empezar esta persona, y es a tiempo completo?
G6.reason: Me gradúo en junio de 2027. Antes de eso estoy disponible para prácticas y trabajo remoto a medio tiempo, no a tiempo completo.
G6.near_note: La fecha de inicio cae en mi último semestre. Medio tiempo hasta junio de 2027 y tiempo completo después es posible, pero hay que decirlo en voz alta y no descubrirlo en la segunda semana.
G6.fail_note: Este puesto necesita a alguien a tiempo completo antes de 2027. Soy estudiante hasta junio de 2027, así que es un conflicto real, no una preferencia.
G6.pass_note: Los tiempos funcionan. O es a medio tiempo, o empieza después de graduarme en junio de 2027.

C1.label: Ambigüedad del problema
C1.question: ¿Qué tan definido está un problema cuando se lo pasas a alguien?
options: Nadie sabe todavía cuál es la pregunta

C2.label: Mezcla de análisis y construcción
C2.question: ¿Este puesto analiza y construye a la vez?
options: Solo lo uno o lo otro
Sobre todo uno, algo del otro
La misma persona analiza y entrega

C5.label: Contenido cuantitativo
C5.question: ¿Cuánto de este trabajo es cuantitativo?
options: El trabajo cuantitativo es el núcleo

C7.label: Solapamiento de capacidades
C7.question: ¿De cuáles de estos grupos de capacidades tira realmente el puesto?
options: Dos o más, de forma central

C8.label: Autonomía esperada
C8.question: ¿Cuánta autonomía conlleva el puesto?
options: El trabajo se asigna y se revisa a diario
Es dueño de los resultados, consulta cuando hace falta
Encuentra el trabajo y decide qué importa
